title: Chapter 373: Friend Or Foe
content:
Chapter 373: Friend Or Foe

At this moment, she admired Lu Daosheng even more.

Soon, under the guidance of Jiang Xiaoxiao, everyone entered the city.

At the same time, the people in the deserted city quickly learned what was going on and what was going on.

The ancestors of the three major families in the inner city are now gathering together, with a faint smile on their faces.

"Haha, it seems that I'm going to change the map again."

The ancestor of the Li family smiled.

Upon hearing this, the ancestor of the Zhang family nodded slightly, but looked puzzled, "But this time it's strange. In the past, the city lord came to take us personally, but this time, someone was sent."

"Maybe the city lord has encountered any difficulties?"

Hearing this, the Li family ancestor changed his face, "No way."

He couldn't believe what difficulties the omnipotent city lord would encounter.

At this time, the ancestor of the Liu family, who had been silent, spoke.

"Okay, don't guess anymore."

"Of course, the city lord won't have any trouble. If there is really a problem, how could he send someone to pick us up?"

Upon hearing this, the ancestor of the Li family and the ancestor of the Zhang family nodded slightly and expressed their agreement.

"But this time, I think it's time to let the tribesmen go out and make a breakthrough."

"Yes, you can't stay in the city all your life. The outside world will be very exciting."

"I agree."

......

A few minutes later, the entire wasteland city began to tremble.

And at this moment, sounds came from outside the city.

"The Palace of Cause and Effect comes to pay homage to the deserted city!"

"The Palace of Destiny comes to pay homage to the deserted city!"

"The Palace of Time and Space comes to pay homage to the deserted city!"

"Come to the Palace of Reincarnation to pay homage to the deserted city!"

"The Palace of Void comes to pay homage to the deserted city!"

Countless figures appeared outside the deserted city. They looked in the direction of the deserted city with a respectful expression.

"And our Nether Sea!"

"The other side of the starry sky is also there!"

After the words came, another figure appeared, which was much stronger than everyone else.

It is Master Yuanji.

He looked at the deserted city with emotion.

I never thought that Lu Daosheng could do this.

He ascended with the entire deserted city.

But he was not disappointed.

Because he knew that what Lu Daosheng had to do was not only to take Huangcheng away from here, but to open up the entire new world.

Thinking of this, the corners of his mouth unconsciously raised slightly.

He looked at a certain place in the deserted city with his eyes.

Time and space win suddenly feel something.

At the same time, a voice sounded in his heart.

"Boy, follow your choice, the way is at your feet, go with confidence!"

In an instant, Shikong Ying's eyes were wet. He looked at the Venerable Yuanji who was standing not far from the deserted city with red eyes, and knelt heavily on the ground.

"Sir, take care of yourself!"

At this time, the deserted city began to gradually shrink.

The huge wasteland city shrank to the size of a palm at a speed visible to the naked eye.

In the end, Jiang Xiaoxiao fell steadily into his palm.

Looking at the deserted city in his hand, Jiang Xiaoxiao couldn't help but smile.

This feeling is really cool.

After taking a look at the world for the last time, Jiang Xiaoxiao stopped hesitating and held the deserted city with one hand to soar!

.........

Chaos Realm.

During this period, the human race has started a war with the Heavenly God Clan, the Divine Power Clan, and the Divine Blood Clan.

The cruelty of the war is no less than the last human genocide crisis.

However, this time, the three gods suffered heavy casualties.

Under the leadership of the three heroes of the human race, the powerful human race have already killed in the small world of the Gods.

It can be said that it is a great pleasure to avenge the previous shame.

"Damn it, this human race is really too bullying!"

"The Shadow Clan is also extremely hateful. When they asked them to do their best, they didn't see them working so hard!"

At this moment, the powerful men of the Shadow Clan are still standing outside their small world, and their hands constantly release the power of space that can distort space.

If this continues, their small world will fall apart soon.

They don't have much time anymore.

The head of the Tianshen clan looked gloomy and asked at the tribe members beside him, "Is there no news yet?"

The tribe members shook their heads, their faces also looked a little ugly.

"Clan leader, the restrictions in the Chaos Realm seem to have been aggravated a lot, and there is no news at all."

Hearing this, the head of the Heavenly God clan clenched his fists and gritted his teeth and said, "This is damn,,,"

He didn't finish speaking.

But everyone present knew that the leader of the God clan was scolding the Supreme Law.

None of them knew that this was not done by the supreme law, but by Lu Daosheng.

Before leaving, Lu Daosheng took action to strengthen the external barriers of the Chaos Realm. Not only did outsiders unable to enter, but it also blocked the information connection between the internal and external realms.

The three gods now seem to be in a desperate situation.

They are not opponents at all when facing the highest combat power of the human race.

The only way is to invite foreign players, just like the human race.

But now, their call for help cannot be spread at all, and their ancestors cannot rush back to save them.

"Can you really have to admit defeat and beg for mercy?"

The clan leader of the Divine Blood Clan had no initial aura at this moment, but instead became more and more decadent.

The atmosphere in the hall gradually became depressed, and everyone remained silent for a long time.

On the other hand, the human race is in a high momentum.

The head of the Shadow Clan had a bright smile on his face, and he smiled respectfully at Lu Xue who was sitting on a high place, "Do not worry, Lord, give me the Shadow Clan some time, and we will definitely destroy the small world of the God Clan!"

Hearing this, Lu Xue nodded in appreciation, "Good job."

At this moment, her face suddenly changed and she looked up at the sky.

Not only her, but the rest of the strong are the same.

At this moment, a long-lost movement suddenly came from the sky.

"Huh? Is it the foreign aid of the Three Gods?!"

On the battlefield, An Chang frowned and said with a bad expression.

The Wu Shang's face was also a little gloomy.

"It's likely that."

The three gods have pushed forward again and again. If this continues, their destruction will be a matter of time sooner or later.

If you don’t look for foreign players, the only thing waiting for them will be destroyed.

An Chang was silent for a moment and said directly: "Go and notify the Lord of the Palace."

The combined strength of the three gods is not weak. If the human race had not had the three of them fighting power ceilings, they would have long since been beaten to face the three gods with full combat power.

And now, the strong men of the Three Gods seem to be coming.

The Palace Master’s father is not here again, and it seems they should change their strategy.

Buzz —

Above the sky.

The clouds are covered with lightning and thunder are roaring.

Everyone knew that this was the supreme law that was blocking the other party.

However, just as everyone could see God, the Supreme Law suddenly began to fade away quickly.

The dark clouds dispersed and a huge crack appeared in front of everyone.

"Huh? What's going on?"

In the small world of the God Clan.

The tribe leader of the three gods stood in the void, frowned.

"The person who comes is an enemy or a friend."
